ff_hawker.name: Frostbound Hawker
ff_hawker.desc: A stall-keeper frozen mid-patter, mouth open on a word. Frost has glazed the apron stiff as tin. It will sell you anything, and the price is always your attention.

moves.name: Sales Pitch
moves.tell: leans in, selling something nobody wants

moves.name: Haggle
moves.tell: names a price

moves.name: Last Bargain
moves.tell: slams the counter

ff_skater.name: Phantom Skater
ff_skater.desc: A skater in a long coat, turning on the ice with no sound at all. The blades leave no mark. Its breath does not fog, and it never once looks down.

moves.name: Blade Pass
moves.tell: cuts a quick arc across the ice

moves.name: Figure Eight
moves.tell: carves a slow loop around you

moves.name: Double Axel
moves.tell: pushes off hard

ff_horse.name: Carousel Horse
ff_horse.desc: A carousel horse come down off its pole, painted eyes rolling, the brass pole still through its back. Under the frost the paint is very bright, and one ear still wears a child's ribbon.

moves.name: Gallop
moves.tell: rears and strikes sparks of frost from the ice

moves.name: Round and Round
moves.tell: begins to spin on its pole

moves.name: Brass Pole
moves.tell: lowers its brass pole

moves.name: Music Box Gutter
moves.tell: falters as the music inside it stutters and slows

ff_ice_figure.name: Ice Figure
ff_ice_figure.desc: A sculpture of a townsperson, carved for the Fair and posed to speak. The likeness is the best the Fair ever had. It is about to say something. It has been about to for fifty years.

moves.name: Brittle Embrace
moves.tell: opens its arms, smiling

moves.name: Hold the Pose
moves.tell: goes perfectly, beautifully still

moves.name: Shatter
moves.tell: begins to crack; it is about to come apart and take you with it

ff_lamp.name: Hung Lamp
ff_lamp.desc: A tin lantern off one of the poles, tagged with a family's name in a child's hand. Something small and blue is burning in it, wanting a wick to belong to.

moves.name: Gutter
moves.tell: gutters, leaning toward your flame

moves.name: Dim
moves.tell: dwindles to a blue thread

moves.name: Swing
moves.tell: swings out on its chain

ff_below_sleeper.name: Sleeper Below
ff_below_sleeper.desc: One of the Fair's winter dead, laid out neatly in the undercroft with a folded coat for a pillow. It is not quite asleep. Nobody ever came to wake it.

moves.name: Dream Strike
moves.tell: stirs, mouth open on a name

moves.name: Cold Sleep
moves.tell: sighs, and the air gets heavier

moves.name: Lullaby
moves.tell: hums two bars of something old

ff_ringmaster.name: The Ringmaster of Rime
ff_ringmaster.desc: A man in a ringmaster's coat, frost in his moustache, his top hat tipped at an angle that has not changed in fifty years. Across his waistcoat hangs a watch-chain, and on the chain a brass key stamped FAIRWARDEN.

moves.name: Whip Crack
moves.tell: flicks his whip

moves.name: Roll Up!
moves.tell: tips his hat and the carousel answers

moves.name: Grand Finale
moves.tell: takes a bow

moves.name: Spotlight
moves.tell: swings a lantern onto you

phases.msg: The music box under the carousel starts to play, and the horses begin, slowly, to go around.

moves.name: Whip Crack
moves.tell: flicks his whip

moves.name: Roll Up!
moves.tell: tips his hat and the carousel answers

moves.name: Grand Finale
moves.tell: takes a bow

moves.name: Spotlight
moves.tell: swings a lantern onto you

moves.name: Merry-Go-Round
moves.tell: sets the horses going around

ff_lampmaster.name: Lamp-Master Hobb
ff_lampmaster.desc: Hobb Ardent, Lamp-Master of the Fair at Wintering: a tall man in a coat of hung lamps, a long pole across his shoulders, holding the dead Great Lantern like a child. He swore to hold the Fair until the flame came home, and he has held it.

moves.name: Lamp-Pole Sweep
moves.tell: swings the long pole low

moves.name: Hoarfrost Breath
moves.tell: breathes out a white fog

moves.name: Lend Me Yours
moves.tell: holds out a hand for your flame

moves.name: Hang the Lamps
moves.tell: claps, and the poles above him light with faces

moves.name: Midwinter Toll
moves.tell: lifts the Lantern; the frost on the walls begins to ring

phases.msg: Hobb lifts the dead Great Lantern. Six hundred empty lamps flicker on their poles, and every one of them has a face in it.

moves.name: Lamp-Pole Sweep
moves.tell: swings the long pole low

moves.name: Hoarfrost Breath
moves.tell: breathes out a white fog

moves.name: Lend Me Yours
moves.tell: holds out a hand for your flame

moves.name: Whiteout
moves.tell: makes the lamps flare white, all at once

moves.name: Midwinter Toll
moves.tell: lifts the Lantern; the frost on the walls begins to ring

moves.name: Hang the Lamps
moves.tell: claps, and the poles above him light with faces

phases.msg: The Lamp-Master sees your lantern properly, for the first time. 'Did he send you? Is it spring?' ... 'Then hold the Fair. HOLD IT.'

moves.name: Hold the Fair
moves.tell: plants his pole and will not be moved

moves.name: Frozen Hour
moves.tell: stands perfectly still, and the cold stands with him

moves.name: Lend Me Yours
moves.tell: holds out a hand for your flame

moves.name: Lamp-Pole Sweep
moves.tell: swings the long pole low

flavour: He stands very still, one hand on the cold post. The lamps hang quiet. He looks, for once, tired.
He moves like a man who has held a tray for fifty years and is thinking of putting it down.
He stands exactly as the Fair remembers him: the coat of lamps, the long pole, the patient smile.
Every dark lamp in the square has begun to glow, a faint and hungry blue, and the frost on your sleeve crackles.
The Great Lantern in his arms blazes white with borrowed cold. The whole Fair is holding its breath behind him.
